Create X12 Indices

Source: R/create_index.R
create_index.Rd

Create X12 Indices

Arguments

x

raw X12 text input

...

dots

Value

an <hcc::IndexX12> S7 object

Examples

create_index(x = c(x12_820[c(1L, 17L)], x12_834[1], x12_837I[1], x12_837P[1]))
